description: Place a paper spot order. coinId is a coin UCID, NOT a ticker. orderType market/limit/stop. limitPrice required for limit & stop; stopPrice required for stop. idempotencyKey is REQUIRED and unique per intent (reuse replays the original result — retry a timed-out call with the SAME key; it will never double-execute). Requires the trade:spot scope. CONFIRM with the user before calling. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique per intent; reuse replays the original result.

orderType.description: Order execution type: market, limit, or stop.

side.description: Spot side: buy spends USDT; sell spends the base coin.
